standard.summary: 权重策略（weighting_scheme）：下列可选值说明含换档影响。
standard.effect: 不同枚举会改变算法目标、资源占用或导出兼容性。
standard.whenToUse: 先默认，再按显存/质量/兼容目标换档。
standard.avoidWhen: 未做短测对照前不要同时叠多个激进实验档。

optionDescriptions.sigma_sqrt: 按 √σ 加权，高噪声/结构段更重。
optionDescriptions.logit_normal: 中等噪声更重，语义段吃得多一点。
optionDescriptions.mode: 跟 mode 时间分布配套的权重。
optionDescriptions.cosmap: 另一条中频偏好曲线，可跟 logit_normal 对着试。

standard_en.summary: Weighting scheme (weighting_scheme): the values below include what changing gear does.
standard_en.effect: Different enum values change the algorithm's target, its resource use, or export compatibility.
standard_en.whenToUse: Start on the default, then change gear according to your VRAM, quality or compatibility goal.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not stack several aggressive experimental gears before running a short controlled test.

optionDescriptions.sigma_sqrt: Weighted by sqrt(sigma), so the high-noise structural range counts more.
optionDescriptions.logit_normal: Mid noise counts more, so the semantic range gets a little more.
optionDescriptions.mode: The weighting that goes with the mode timestep distribution.
optionDescriptions.cosmap: Another mid-frequency preference curve, worth trying against logit_normal.
